verdict.rationale: Pendo documents some public REST API operations: track events can be sent as REST API calls, and an API endpoint bulk-deletes accounts and visitors. That shows the product can be driven programmatically, but the evidence covers only narrow slices of functionality, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. The mobile SDK APIs and the MCP server belong to other stories and are not credited here. Missing for 10: evidence of broad API coverage of core product functions (guides, analytics queries, segments), a published machine-readable API spec/reference, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: You can use the API endpoint to delete accounts and visitors without contacting our support team.
